accessPolicy.licenseLabel: WHO-owned ICD-10; national-modification use requires authority-specific licensing review
accessPolicy.note: NCHS publishes the official U.S. clinical modification under WHO authorization for U.S. government purposes. CDC states that WHO owns ICD-10, and WHO's ICD-10 licensing FAQ directs users of U.S. ICD-10-CM to NCHS for licensing. The current ICD-11 CC BY-ND terms do not establish rights in ICD-10-CM. PsychSim therefore keeps the exact F01-F99 code-title catalog as a gitignored local U.S. authoring cache under a narrow documented fair-use assessment; it is not redistributed or imported into runtime, and no coding text becomes diagnostic criteria. A manual July 24, 2026 audit found no F01-F99 code/title changes in the April 1, 2026 tabular update; the update artifact is hash-pinned, but that comparison is not yet an automated validator.
